deal.product_description: A 10.1‑inch IPS touchscreen digital calendar with 1280x800 resolution, 32 GB built‑in storage, Wi‑Fi connectivity, two‑way sync with Google Calendar, iCloud, Outlook, Cozi, and Yahoo via URL, photo‑frame mode with video support, and a chore chart featuring color‑coded labels and reward points.

A compact all‑in‑one inkjet printer with a 2‑cartridge hybrid ink system, dual‑band Wi‑Fi (2.4 GHz/5 GHz), automatic duplex printing, and a flatbed scanner/copy function. Supports media up to 8.5 × 11 in and includes a 1‑year limited warranty.
